annotation.title_clean: IEEE 2863-2026 - IEEE Approved Draft Recommended Practice for Organizational Governance of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: IEEE 2863-2026 - IEEE Approved Draft Recommended Practice for Organizational Governance of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association, Artificial Intelligence Standards Committee (C/AISC)
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA catalogue page for IEEE 2863-2026, a recommended practice on organizational governance of AI. It sets governance principles and processes for governing bodies of organizations developing or using AI, with case studies showing how to resolve tensions between principles. General AI, no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets governance activities for organizations developing or using AI
Provides governance principles for governing bodies to prioritize
Provides processes to implement the principles
Includes case studies on resolving tensions between principles
